Title: PRE-FLIGHT - Returns module installed, Return setting on, Admin SPA Returns list reachable (suite BLOCKED, not FAIL, when missing)
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. ENVIRONMENT REQUIRED BY THIS SUITE: (a) module VirtoCommerce.Return installed (GET /api/platform/modules lists "Returns" with isInstalled=true; menu More > Returns exists); (b) store Settings > Return > Return: "Return module" ON (default OFF on a new store), "Order statuses allowing returns" contains Completed; (c) return:read, return:update and return:authorize held by the admin; (d) legacy returns and buyer-submitted returns (Requested) exist for the cases that need them; (e) email delivery is not required
Steps: 1. Open More > Returns\n2. Wait for the grid\n3. Open Stores > the store > Settings and expand Return > Return
Expected Result: 1. The Returns list opens without an error toast and shows the status filter and the grid\n2. Return module reads ON for the store\n3. A miss in any of (a)-(c) means the whole suite is BLOCKED naming the missing prerequisite - never FAIL
References: VCST-5628 · VCST-5883 · environment gate (see suites 073a, 073b, 050o, 014c for the same list)

Title: Create return from existing order
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. At least one order exists with shipped items
Steps:
1. Navigate to Returns workspace
2. Click 'Add new return' button
3. Select an existing order from the order picker
4. Select one or more items to return
5. Enter return reason and quantity
6. Click Save
Expected Result:
1. Return is created successfully with status 'New'
2. Return number is auto-generated
3. Return appears in the returns grid
4. Linked order number is displayed correctly
5. Item count matches selected items

Title: View return details
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. At least one return exists in the grid
Steps: 1. Navigate to Returns workspace\n2. Click on an existing return row in the grid
Expected Result:
1. Return detail blade opens
2. All fields are displayed: Return number, Order number, Customer, Status, Create date, Modify date, Created by, Item count
3. Return items list is visible with quantities and reasons
4. Data matches what is shown in the grid row

Title: Edit return details
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. A return in 'New' status exists
Steps:
1. Navigate to Returns workspace
2. Open an existing return in 'New' status
3. Modify the return reason or item quantity
4. Click Save
5. Close the blade and reopen the same return
Expected Result:
1. Save completes without errors
2. Modify date is updated
3. Changes are persisted after closing and reopening the blade
4. API PUT request returns 200/204 status code

Title: Delete a return
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. A return in 'New' status exists
Steps:
1. Navigate to Returns workspace
2. Select a return in 'New' status
3. Click Delete button
4. Confirm the deletion dialog
Expected Result:
1. Return is removed from the grid
2. Grid refreshes and return no longer appears
3. Attempting to access the deleted return by direct URL shows appropriate error
4. API DELETE request returns 200/204

Title: Search returns by return number and order number
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. Multiple returns exist in the grid
Steps:
1. Navigate to Returns workspace
2. Enter a known return number in the search field
3. Verify filtered results
4. Clear search
5. Enter a known order number in the search field
6. Verify filtered results
Expected Result:
1. Search by return number shows only matching returns
2. Search by order number shows returns linked to that order
3. Clearing search restores full list
4. Search is case-insensitive
5. No results message displayed when search has no matches

Title: Transition a legacy New return to Processing
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. A return in 'New' status exists (admin-created through the legacy Add new return, never submitted by a buyer)
Steps:
1. Navigate to Returns workspace (More > Returns)
2. Open the return in 'New' status
3. Open the status dropdown and note the options (the source is GET /api/return/{id}/available-statuses)
4. Change status to 'Processing'
5. Click Save
6. Verify the status in the grid
Expected Result:
1. Processing is offered for a New return and is saved
2. Modify date is updated and the grid reflects the new status
3. The change persists after a page refresh
4. A plain status change is silent: no email and no push message is sent for it (only Approve/decline and Cancel notify)
5. The units held by the return are unchanged
References: VCST-5883 · repaired 2026-10 against the Step-1/Step-2 lifecycle (Draft, Requested, Approved, PartiallyApproved, Rejected, Cancelled; legacy New, Processing, Completed). Admin decisions: suite 073b; REST contract: suite 073a.

Title: Transition return status from Processing to Completed
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. A return in 'Processing' status exists (a New return moved to Processing as in RET-006, or a decided return)
Steps:
1. Navigate to Returns workspace
2. Open a return in 'Processing' status
3. Change status to 'Completed'
4. Click Save
5. Verify the status in the grid
Expected Result:
1. Status changes to 'Completed' and is saved
2. Modify date is updated and the grid reflects the new status
3. No earlier status (Draft, New, Requested) is offered afterwards: the dropdown moves forward only
4. The change is silent: no email and no push message is sent, and the units held by the return are unchanged
References: VCST-5883 · repaired 2026-10 against the Step-1/Step-2 lifecycle (Draft, Requested, Approved, PartiallyApproved, Rejected, Cancelled; legacy New, Processing, Completed). Admin decisions: suite 073b; REST contract: suite 073a.

Title: Rejected cannot be chosen from the status dropdown - a return becomes Rejected only by declining every line
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. A Requested return exists (a buyer submitted it) and a legacy return in 'Processing' status exists
Steps:
1. Navigate to Returns workspace
2. Open the Requested return and open the status dropdown
3. Open the legacy Processing return and open its status dropdown
4. Open the Requested return, open Line items > Approve / decline, set every line to approved 0 with a decline reason, confirm
Expected Result: 1. The status dropdown of the Requested and of the Processing return does not offer Rejected, Approved or PartiallyApproved (decision statuses are reachable only through Approve / decline)\n2. Declining every line gives status Rejected, each line state Rejected, and the buyer is notified\n3. Rejected is terminal: its dropdown offers only Rejected
References: VCST-5883 · repaired 2026-10 against the Step-1/Step-2 lifecycle (Draft, Requested, Approved, PartiallyApproved, Rejected, Cancelled; legacy New, Processing, Completed). Admin decisions: suite 073b; REST contract: suite 073a. See RET-ADM-004, RET-ADM-006, RET-AUTH-025/026.

Title: Backward and sideways status transitions are not offered after Completed or after a decision
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. A return in 'Completed' status exists and a decided return (Approved, PartiallyApproved or Rejected) exists
Steps:
1. Navigate to Returns workspace
2. Open the Completed return and open the status dropdown
3. Open a decided return and open the status dropdown
4. Compare each dropdown with GET /api/return/{id}/available-statuses
Expected Result:
1. The Completed return's dropdown offers no New, Processing, Draft or Requested
2. A decided return's dropdown offers no Draft, New or Requested and no other decision status; "Cancelled" appears at most once and the legacy "Canceled" never appears
3. Rejected and Cancelled returns offer only their own status
4. Each dropdown equals the endpoint list, each value once
References: VCST-5883 · repaired 2026-10 against the Step-1/Step-2 lifecycle (Draft, Requested, Approved, PartiallyApproved, Rejected, Cancelled; legacy New, Processing, Completed). Admin decisions: suite 073b; REST contract: suite 073a. See RET-ADM-006, RET-AUTH-017/025.

Title: Filter returns grid by status
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. Returns exist in several statuses among New, Requested, Processing, Completed, Approved, PartiallyApproved, Rejected, Cancelled
Steps:
1. Navigate to Returns workspace
2. Apply the status filter 'Requested' and note the rows and the count
3. Repeat for Approved, PartiallyApproved, Rejected, Cancelled, Processing and Completed
4. Remove all filters
Expected Result:
1. Each status filter shows only returns of that status
2. The displayed count equals the rows across pages
3. Removing filters restores the full list
4. The filter offers the Requested status (buyer-submitted returns)
References: VCST-5883 · repaired 2026-10 against the Step-1/Step-2 lifecycle (Draft, Requested, Approved, PartiallyApproved, Rejected, Cancelled; legacy New, Processing, Completed). Admin decisions: suite 073b; REST contract: suite 073a. See RET-ADM-009.

Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in
Steps:

2. Click 'Add new return'

Title: The same order line cannot be listed twice on one return, and the sum over open returns never exceeds what is returnable
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. A return exists that holds part of an order line, and a Requested return with a line for another order line
Steps:
1. Navigate to Returns workspace
2. Open the Requested return and add a second line for an order line that is already on it (Line items)
3. Click Save
4. Create another return for the same order and request more units of an already-held line than remain returnable
5. Click Save
Expected Result:
1. Saving a return that lists one order line twice is refused with a message containing "listed more than once"; nothing is saved (REST: 400)
2. Requesting more than the remaining returnable quantity is refused and no return is created
3. The total held across Requested, Approved and PartiallyApproved returns for one order line never exceeds the ordered/delivered quantity
4. Draft, Cancelled and Rejected returns hold nothing and do not reduce the remaining quantity
References: VCST-5883 · repaired 2026-10 against the Step-1/Step-2 lifecycle (Draft, Requested, Approved, PartiallyApproved, Rejected, Cancelled; legacy New, Processing, Completed). Admin decisions: suite 073b; REST contract: suite 073a. REST contract: RET-AUTH-018/022.

Title: Return quantity above the returnable quantity is refused
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. An order exists whose line has a known returnable quantity N (ordered/delivered minus what open returns hold)
Steps:
1. Navigate to Returns workspace
2. Click 'Add new return' and select the order
3. Enter a return quantity greater than N for that line
4. Attempt to save
Expected Result: 1. The save is refused with a validation message about the quantity (no 500, no partial save)\n2. The return is not created\n3. The maximum accepted quantity equals the returnable quantity N, which is also what the buyer-facing returnableItems shows
References: VCST-5883 · repaired 2026-10 against the Step-1/Step-2 lifecycle (Draft, Requested, Approved, PartiallyApproved, Rejected, Cancelled; legacy New, Processing, Completed). Admin decisions: suite 073b; REST contract: suite 073a. Buyer-side boundary: 050o RET-GQL-020/022.

Title: Required fields validation on return creation
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in
Steps:
1. Navigate to Returns workspace
2. Click 'Add new return'
3. Select an order but leave return reason empty
4. Leave item quantity at zero or empty
5. Attempt to save
Expected Result:

Steps:
1. Navigate to Returns workspace
2. Open a return and note the Order number

Title: Customer name on return matches linked order customer
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. Multiple returns exist for different customers
Steps:
1. Navigate to Returns workspace
2. Note the Customer column for several returns
3. Open each return and verify customer name
4. Cross-reference with the linked order's customer
Expected Result:

Title: Completed return triggers inventory restoration
Preconditions:
1. Admin user is logged in
2. Track inventory is enabled
3. An order exists with items that decremented stock
4. A return in 'Processing' status exists for that order
Steps:
1. Note current inventory count for the returned item
2. Navigate to Returns workspace
3. Open the return in 'Processing' status
4. Change status to 'Completed'
5. Save the return
6. Navigate to Inventory module
7. Check the stock quantity for the returned item
Expected Result:
1. Inventory quantity increases by the returned item quantity
2. Inventory adjustment is logged if change logging is enabled
3. Stock count matches: previous count + returned quantity
4. Fulfillment center stock is updated correctly
References: HELD 2026-10: no requirement in VCST-5628/VCST-5883 says completing a return restores stock - the Return module raises no order-side or inventory event (domain map D9). Do not execute until the PO states whether stock restoration is intended; then author it against that decision.

Title: Return line price is the order line snapshot and stays editable in the Admin; there is no refund amount
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. A return exists with lines whose order prices are known
Steps:
1. Navigate to Returns workspace
2. Open a return and open the Line items blade
3. Compare each line price with the price of the same line on the linked order
4. Edit one line price and click Save, reopen the return
Expected Result:
1. Each line price and currency equal the order line item's price (a snapshot, not the current catalog price)
2. The edited price persists after Save, even on a decided line (by design)
3. No refund amount or payment refund exists on the return; completing it triggers no payment action
4. The storefront shows no return prices (the xAPI has no price fields: 050o RET-GQL-043)
References: VCST-5883 · repaired 2026-10 against the Step-1/Step-2 lifecycle (Draft, Requested, Approved, PartiallyApproved, Rejected, Cancelled; legacy New, Processing, Completed). Admin decisions: suite 073b; REST contract: suite 073a. REST: RET-AUTH-035.

Title: Sort returns grid by all sortable columns
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. Multiple returns exist with different values
Steps:
1. Navigate to Returns workspace
2. Click on 'Return number' column header to sort ascending
3. Click again to sort descending
4. Repeat for: Order number, Customer, Return status, Create date, Modify date, Created by, Item count
Expected Result:
1. Each column sorts correctly in ascending and descending order
2. Sort indicator (arrow) shows current sort direction
3. Numeric columns sort numerically, dates sort chronologically, text sorts alphabetically
4. Grid updates without errors after each sort

Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. More returns exist than the default page size (e.g., more than 20)
Steps:
1. Navigate to Returns workspace
2. Verify the default page shows limited results
3. Click next page or scroll to load more
4. Navigate back to the first page
5. Change page size if option is available
Expected Result:
1. Pagination controls are displayed when results exceed page size
2. Navigating pages shows correct data without duplicates
3. Total count is displayed and accurate
4. Page size change refreshes the grid with the correct number of rows

Title: Grid column visibility and data completeness
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. Returns exist in the grid
Steps: 1. Navigate to Returns workspace\n2. Verify all expected columns are visible: Return number, Order number, Customer, Return status, Create date, Modify date, Created by, Item count\n3. Check that no column has missing or null data for existing returns
Expected Result:
1. All 8 columns are visible in the grid
2. No columns show empty or 'undefined' values for existing returns
3. Column widths allow data to be readable without excessive truncation
4. Date columns display in a consistent format

Title: Bulk select and delete multiple returns
Preconditions: 1. Admin user is logged in\n2. Multiple returns in 'New' status exist
Steps:
1. Navigate to Returns workspace
2. Select multiple returns using checkboxes
3. Click the Delete button
4. Confirm the bulk deletion dialog
5. Verify the grid after deletion
Expected Result:
1. Multiple returns can be selected via checkboxes
2. Delete button is enabled when returns are selected
3. Confirmation dialog shows the count of returns to be deleted
4. All selected returns are removed from the grid after confirmation
